opp.back_in_city: A suspect you detained is back in the city.
opp.detail.evade: Suspect {label}: left within {window} s of contact (contact {seconds} s ago)
opp.detail.offline_at_open: Suspect {label}: offline when the case opened and not back in time
opp.detail.fake_arena: Suspect {label}: another script's arena flag outside any instance
flag.rs_fake_arena_flag: A suspect carried another script's arena flag in the open world. He stayed in the case.
flag.rs_teleport: A suspect moved faster than a player can (teleport or noclip).
flag.rs_combat_log: A suspect logged off or switched character during the case.
flag.rs_volunteer_dropout: A volunteer suspect said yes, then did not reach the starting point in time or cancelled the case (a strike when it came late).
flag.rs_evade_instance: A suspect went into an instance (an apartment, Crimson-Arena or another world) during the case.
flag.rs_went_on_duty: A suspect went on police duty during the case and no longer counts.
opp.detail.self_uncuff: Suspect {label}: the cuffs came off {seconds} s after the cuff with no officer uncuff, bobby pin or cuff-break game (self-uncuff or admin reset)
opp.detail.afk_catch: Suspect {label}: AFK by his samples when he was caught, so the catch scores nothing
opp.detail.outside_jail: Suspect {label}: jailed for {months} months by someone outside the case
opp.detail.outside_uncuff: Suspect {label}: uncuffed {seconds} s after the cuff by {name} (server id {by}), who is not in the case
opp.detail.early_respawn: Suspect {label}: respawned at a hospital {seconds} s after going down (the death timer is {limit} s)
opp.detail.respawn_not_down: Suspect {label}: respawned at a hospital while not down
flag.rs_self_uncuff: A suspect's cuffs came off during the custody hold with no officer uncuff, rescue or cuff-break game: a self-uncuff (/fixcuffs) or an admin's /resetcuffs. It counts as detained.
flag.rs_outside_jail: Someone outside the case jailed a suspect. Nobody scores his detain or booking.
flag.rs_outside_uncuff: Someone outside the case uncuffed a suspect during the custody hold (sc-police lets anyone with handcuffs do it). It counts as detained.
flag.rs_early_respawn: A suspect respawned at a hospital before the death timer ran out (or while not down). He no longer counts.
flag.rs_afk_catch: A suspect was AFK when he was caught. The catch scores nothing.
opp.state.cuffed: cuffed (the custody hold was not over)
opp.detail.force_custody: Suspect {label}: hit by this officer while {state}
opp.detail.force_down: Suspect {label}: hit by this officer {seconds} s after going down, after earlier hits by the case's officers
opp.detail.unarmed_shot: Suspect {label}: shot by this officer, never seen armed in the case
opp.detail.ran_over: Suspect {label}: run over on foot by this officer
opp.detail.bad_seize: Suspect {label}: this officer used Seize Cash on him while {state}, {metres} m away
opp.detail.bad_seize_outsider: Suspect {label}: {name} (server id {by}), who is not in the case, used Seize Cash on him while {state}, {metres} m away
opp.seize.other_case: suspect {label} of a case he is not in
opp.audit.seize_cash: Seize Cash used (sc-police takes nothing when the target has no cash). Target: {target}; server distance {metres} m; in custody (CP-cuffed): {cuffed}
flag.rs_excessive_force: An officer hit a real suspect who was still in custody (cuffed, or detained while down), or kept hitting him after he went down. His points wait for a supervisor (voiding his row in Review fails it).
flag.rs_unarmed_shot: An officer shot a real suspect who was never seen armed in the case. He gets a penalty and his points wait for a supervisor.
flag.rs_vdm: An officer ran a real suspect over while the suspect was on foot. He gets a penalty and his points wait for a supervisor.
flag.rs_bad_seize: An officer used Seize Cash on a real suspect who was not under arrest, or from more than 3 m away (with or without cash taken). An officer of the case: his points wait for a supervisor.
penalty.rs_unarmed_shot: Shot a suspect who was never armed
penalty.rs_ran_over: Ran a suspect over on foot
admin.action.seizeCash: Seize Cash used in a real-suspect case
err.own_crime: You can't take a case against one of your own characters or accounts.
opp.detail.pair_repeat: Suspect {label}: {count} cases of this officer and this suspect in {days} days, with {sign}
opp.sign.fast_catch: a detain {seconds} s after the case started
opp.sign.no_resistance: a suspect never armed who moved {metres} m after contact
flag.rs_linked_accounts: An officer and a real suspect of his case share a connection or a PC (the same IP address or hardware token). Families and housemates do too, so a supervisor checks it: his points wait for review.
flag.rs_pair_repeat: The same officer and real suspect met in several cases within a few days, with a second warning sign (a very fast catch, a suspect who never fought or ran, or a very short case). His points wait for a supervisor.
run.ended_downed_case: You went down: you leave the case with what you earned so far, and no cooldown
run.ended_downed_kept: Mission failed: you went down (no cooldown)
reason.downed_case: Went down on a live case
opp.detail.outside_cuff: Suspect {label}: cuffed by an officer outside the case with no officer of the case near him, so nobody scores him
flag.rs_outside_cuff: An officer outside the case cuffed a suspect (no officer of the case was near, or Config.RealSuspects.outsideCuff is 'stopped'). Nobody scores his detain or booking.
err.rs_off: Real-suspect cases are off (Config.LiveCrime.enabled and Config.Volunteers.enabled are both false).
err.rs_no_case: That case is no longer kept (only open cases and the last closed ones are, until a restart).
admin.action.rsBlockPair: Real suspects: officer and suspect pair blocked
admin.action.rsExclude: Real suspects: player excluded from being a suspect
admin.action.rsSuspend: Real suspects: officer suspended from these cases
opp.line.offline_at_open: Suspect {label} was offline when the case opened
opp.line.unloaded: Suspect {label} logged out or switched character
opp.line.join_offered: {who} was offered to join the case ({why})
opp.line.cuff_refused: A cuff of suspect {label} by {by} did not count ({why})
opp.line.cuffed_by_outsider: Suspect {label} was cuffed by {by}, outside the case
opp.line.cuffed_unproven: Suspect {label} was cuffed with no officer's cuff to match it
opp.line.uncuff_refused: An uncuff of suspect {label} by {by} did not count ({why})
opp.line.uncuffed_by_outsider: Suspect {label} was uncuffed by {by}, outside the case
opp.line.bobby_pin: Suspect {label} was freed with a bobby pin by {by}
opp.line.spawn_protected: A detain of suspect {label} did not count: hospital protection ({seconds} s left)
opp.line.respawn_in_contact: Suspect {label} respawned with officers still with him: no protection
opp.line.jail_refused: A jail of suspect {label} by {by} ({months} months) was no booking ({why})
opp.line.outside_jail: {by}, outside the case, jailed suspect {label} for {months} months
opp.line.booking_too_short: Suspect {label}: a sentence of {months} months by {by} is too short to book
opp.line.booked_outside_station: Suspect {label}: jailed by {by} outside a booking zone
opp.line.pair_repeat: {who} and suspect {label}: {count} cases in a short time (repeated pairing)
rs.ui.subtitle: Live crimes and volunteer cases: what happened in each case, who met whom, and the block, exclude and suspend tools.
rs.ui.off_banner: Live crimes and volunteers are both off: no new cases open and the tools are refused. Cases and blocks from before are still listed.
rs.ui.cases_sub: Every open case and the last closed ones (Config.RealSuspects.casesKept, until a restart). Click a case to open it.
rs.ui.own: Your case: you can't open it
rs.ui.col.label: Label
rs.ui.flag_lines_sub: Officer-conduct flags hold that officer's points for review; suspect notes never hold anyone's points.
rs.ui.ledger_sub: Weapon hits between the case's officers and its suspects (hits in a row are one line). No position is ever kept here.
rs.ui.pairs_sub: Cases of each officer and suspect from the pair ledger, the most first (at most 200).
rs.ui.pairs_from: Cases of each officer and suspect since {from}, the most first (at most 200).
rs.ui.excluded_until: Excluded from being a suspect until {until}
rs.ui.admin_rows_sub: Running now, the latest end first. Each one runs to its end date.
rs.ui.tool.title: Block, exclude or suspend
rs.ui.tool.desc.block: This officer can't take a case with this suspect in it until the block ends.
rs.ui.tool.desc.exclude: This player is never a suspect until the exclusion ends.
rs.ui.tool.desc.suspend: This officer can't claim or join live crime or volunteer cases until the suspension ends.
rs.ui.tool.no_lift: A longer block, exclusion or suspension replaces a shorter one; none can be lifted early. Every one is in the audit log.
opp.line.volunteer_yes: Suspect {label} is a volunteer who said yes (asked: {count})
opp.line.engaged: Officers reached suspect {label}: the case is engaged
opp.line.no_show: Suspect {label} did not reach the starting point in time (no-show)
opp.line.volunteer_npc: Suspect {label} dropped out: the NPC plays the suspect
opp.line.volunteer_afk: Suspect {label} was caught while AFK: his part is void
opp.line.volunteer_out_of_bounds: Suspect {label} stayed outside the search area: his part is void
rs.ui.volunteers_sub: Players on the volunteer list now (Config.Volunteers), with their strikes and whether a mission is asking them or they play one. Memory only: a restart clears it.
opp.line.talk_down: {by} asked suspect {label} to surrender (Talk them down)
opp.line.talk_refused: Suspect {label} said no to the Talk them down of {by}
opp.line.peaceful_arrest: Peaceful arrest of suspect {label} (talked down by: {by})
err.rs_no_row: That block, exclusion or suspension is not running any more (it ended or was already lifted).
err.rs_no_strikes: That player has no strikes and no strike block right now.
admin.action.rsLift: Real suspects: block, exclusion or suspension lifted early
rs.ui.admin_rows_sub_lift: Running now, the latest end first. Lift ends one now (with a reason, in the audit log).
rs.ui.lift_message: End this {what} now: {who}. It was set to run until {until}.
rs.ui.tool.lift_note: A longer block, exclusion or suspension replaces a shorter one; staff can lift one early under Blocks, exclusions and suspensions. Every one is in the audit log.
rs.ui.clear_message: Clear the strikes and any strike block of {who}. He can volunteer again at once.
